WITH wd AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
sold AS (
    SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sold_net
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND wd.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
ret_web AS (
    SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
ret_line AS (
    SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sku, ROUND(sold_net,2) AS sold_net, ROUND(sold_net-COALESCE(rw.refunds,0),2) AS net_store900_returns, ROUND(sold_net-COALESCE(rl.refunds,0),2) AS net_all_web_line_returns
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret_web rw USING (sku) LEFT JOIN ret_line rl USING (sku)
ORDER BY net_store900_returns DESC LIMIT 14

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand
ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC
